checks.name: cloud local-tool snapshot and first note are durable
switching cloud results restores separate notes
full reload recovers cloud history and notes
late result response cannot overwrite the newer selected result
second isolated account cannot display first account history
browser-only results and per-result notes survive reload without cloud rows
no-save result creates no cloud or browser history entry
account export survives reload and downloads only after explicit check
history export recovers by server metadata with browser job storage removed
reset ignores a late saved snapshot and does not attach new notes to it

limitations: One installed Chromium engine on loopback; no live provider, merchant, OAuth, production or physical second-device acceptance.
